primary.description: Trustworthy corporate blue. Used for primary CTAs, active states, and primary dashboard metrics.

accent.description: Action-oriented orange. Used for Pending Payments, warnings, and secondary call-to-actions.

background.description: Slate-50 for app background, pure White for cards/paper to ensure scannability.

typography.description: Outfit provides a modern, clean, authoritative feel for headings. IBM Plex Sans is highly legible for dense data, tables, and GST numbers.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Functional, dense but breathable. Utilize generous padding in containers, but keep data tables tight for scannability.

button.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary-dark font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2
button.accent: bg-accent text-white hover:bg-accent-dark font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2
button.outline: border border-border text-text-primary hover:bg-background rounded-md px-4 py-2

table.header: bg-background text-text-secondary text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold border-b border-strong

bottom_navigation.style: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white border-t border-border flex justify-around items-center h-16 md:hidden z-50
bottom_navigation.item: flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full text-secondary hover:text-primary

invoice_templates.Classic: Traditional table format, clear grid borders, simple black and white with blue header.
invoice_templates.Modern: Rounded corners, light gray backgrounds for table headers, clean sans-serif.
invoice_templates.Premium: Dark blue accents, sophisticated layout, logo centered, subtle watermarks.
invoice_templates.Industrial: High contrast, thick borders, very structured, perfect for B2B IIP products.
invoice_templates.Blue Professional: Blue primary color dominates the table headers, totals, and accent lines.

icons.description: Duotone weight for high-end SaaS feel on dashboard, regular weight for dense tables.

images.description: Subtle industrial factory background for login or landing page hero section.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All buttons and table rows must have visible hover states with color transitions.
interactions_and_motion.focus_states: Focus states must use ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-1 for accessibility.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for micro-interactions.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='create-invoice-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI components.
Ensure mobile-first responsiveness. The bottom navigation bar is critical for mobile view (md:hidden).
Use a Sidebar for desktop layouts (hidden on mobile).
Create the 5 specified invoice templates in the UI for the user to choose from when generating a PDF.
Integrate the @phosphor-icons/react library for all iconography.
Use IBM Plex Sans for all data-heavy tables and invoices for crisp numerical legibility.
Do not use placeholder URLs for images; use the provided media URLs.
